The '''Somnoire''' is a mysterious and relatively unknown realm deemed a myth by many in [[Solaris-3]] that is related to dreams. It can only be entered through a gateway that only appears at certain locations, guarded by the [[Ebony Gatekeeper|Ebony]] and [[Ivory Gatekeeper]], and inhabited by other entities.

According to the Ebony Gatekeeper, the realm was created by someone the Rover knew, though the Ivory Gatekeeper claims multiple people made it.

==Description==
Little is known about the Somnoire other than its a realm that is claimed to have all the dreams, memories, and emotions of Solaris-3 converge onto it. This causes the realm to be considered bizarre and unnatural due to being made up of humans dreams and memories, which connects to both them and all living beings who have ever lived throughout history. Thus the Somnoire holds different "sections" made up of landscapes that may not make sense in general. The Ebony Gatekeeper states that the Somnoire records everything on Solaris-3 with the [[Rover]] being a crucial component to function properly, and that the Somnoire requires real memories and experience to form these different areas.

These areas can be entered through doors, where the more doors you open, the deeper one goes into the "dream". However, the areas may also be altered when dangerous intrusive beings such as [[Scar]] and [[Dreamless (Boss)|Dreamless]] invade the realm, forming chaos that causes the realm to become more mismatched and allowing [[Tacet Discord]] to appear due to the Somnoire being similar to a [[Tacet Field]], thus becoming intrusive beings that must be defeated before the Somnoire becomes further damaged. 

Whenever one enters the Somnoire, they become an "Onlooker" and cannot bring anything with them. However, they may manifest objects or [[Echoes]] through recorded memories, or being given enhancement items known as [[Depths of Illusive Realm/Metaphors|Metaphors]] and [[Depths of Illusive Realm/Tokens|Tokens]] from inhabitants such as the Gatekeepers or entities known as an Illusia.  At the same time, the Onlooker may assume a different form as Rover does, who may appear as either themselves, or become a different Resonator with their skillset and abilities while enhancing such abilities within the realm. The unique space of the Somnoire may also allow an Onlooker to enter another's dreams and potentially gain an aspect of them for assistance. 

However, the Ivory Gatekeeper explains that only the Rover may enter the Somnoire and leave it at will, as nobody else may see the anomalies or the gateways produced by the Somnoire. Having control over both Gatekeepers and the Somnoire before the Rover wiped their memories and lost this knowledge. Although it is possible for other people to enter the realm under unique circumstances, that being, a part of their consciousness becoming trapped in the realm until one of the Gatekeepers releases them. During that time, the original dreamers are incapable of dreaming until then. 

According to "Dorothy", an inhabitant of the Somnoire, time also functions differently within the realm. Claiming that memories of the inhabitants may stems not from the past, but from the future. This may be a possible due to the Somnoire recording all of Solaris-3's inhabitants memories and dreams across history, even from the future. This may be untrue, however, seeing as [[Fantasies of the Thousand Gateways (Quest)|Fantasies of the Thousand Gateways]] reveals that "Dorothy" was actually the Ebony Gatekeeper, lying so he may set up his plants for the [[Somnium Labyrinth]] expansion. Though during the [[If You Gaze Into the Abyss of Dreams|incident]] where numerous nightmares were released proved that "Dorothy" does exist alongside others, and that the Ebony Gatekeeper was simply using her identity for himself.

Another facet of the realm, as revealed by the Ebony Gatekeeper, is that the Somnoire is an artificial creation that is finite. Despite having tens of millions of gateways that lead to different realms, the amount that can be held is limited. As such, during periodic schedules, the Somnoire must delete countless dreams and memoires to save space through the usage of safety filters and the Ebony Gatekeeper. Though, while it is possible to create more space by expanding the realm into Solaris-3, the consequences are disastrous as they can cause various nightmares and Tacet Discords to manifest and enter the planet, causing untold devastation that endanger the entire world unless it is stopped.

The nature of the Somnoire, as it is a world of dreams, also makes it impossible for anything within the Somnoire to be taken outside of it. Though recent [[Dreaming Deep/Story|events]] has shown that it is possible, with the two Gatekeepers discussing that either the Somnoire has either developed a consciousness of its own or that someone within the Somnoire possesses an ability powerful enough to shatter the boundary between dreams and reality, who are unknown to the Gatekeepers themselves. While the source is unknown, a layer within the Somnoire where certain inhabitants of the realm can create films that utilize the dreams and frequencies of the Somnoire to produce them may be the source itself.

It is also revealed that the entire realm was created for the possibility that a dream may hold the answer to deal with [[the Lament]]. Thus why all dreams are stored until they are reviewed and later deleted for the next dream.

==Dream Nodes==
In [[Ragunna City]], the Rover discovers that despite the realm connecting to other dreams, the [[Strange White Cat|White Cat]] reveals that other locations, such as [[Rinascita]], are blocked off from the Somnoire due to restrictions placed upon admin privileges and the Resonance Nexus. Only when the dream nodes are active can other locations be connected with the dreams shared in the determined area linking with the Somnoire. Though the Somnoire can be granted access from an outside force, with the White Cat claiming that Ragunna could now be accessed, with certain exceptions due to unknown energy blocking off [[Fagaceae Peninsula]] and [[Penitent's End]], up until the Rover dealt with the obstructions and allowing Ragunna to be established properly. 

One problem did occur however where, due to the involvement of [[Leviathan]] and it's spiritual plague in the region, caused numerous impurities to enter the Somnoire as the [[Threnodian]] has infected Rinascita's people which in turn tainted their dreams. The Ebony Gatekeeper was forced to create a [[Fantasies of the Thousand Gateways|gateway]] in Rinascita and seal the impurities behind it and the Memory Zones within. 

==Dream Band==
During the events of Lucy’s arrival on Solaris-3, she caused the formation of a Dream Band. The Ivory Gatekeeper describes it as a manifestation of frequency in the flesh, only appearing in the Somnore under the rarest of conditions. Through it, the Dream Band and the Nightmare Tacet Discord that makes up Adam Smasher are considered two types of the same coin, being perfect inversions of one another. By harnessing the Dream Band, it can counteract the corruption spread by Adam Smasher and even damage him.

Though the Dream Band shattered into three shards when it should be whole, requiring the pieces to be gathered and made whole again while protected from Adam Smasher’s forces who wished to prevent the shards union. Upon reuniting as one, it allowed the embodiment of Lucy’s happiness, David, to reappear again and counter Adam Smasher. Upon Adam Smasher’s defeat, the damage he wrought retracted and vanished away. 

The Dream Band is considered to be very rare, as even the Ivory Gatekeeper never saw one before up until the events of Lucy's arrival. 

==Intrusions==
At times the Somnoire may be invaded by outside forces, be it those who are alive or dead.  While it is unknown how they appear within the Somnoire, intrusive beings such as Scar or Dreamless may also cause interference in the Somnoire, which in turn mixes dreamscapes together. The result being that certain people may look at the same item/entity at the same time, yet each see something else in their perspective.  These anomalies in Somnoire are considered disruptive to the usual laws and order of the realm's space.

Depending on the danger, this may allow Tacet Discords to form and potentially escape the Somnoire, and depending on the situation - transformed and becoming [[Phantom Echo|Phantom]] or [[Nightmare Echo|Nightmare]] variants. One which has occurred in Ragunna, as an unknown threat - identified later as the Threnodian Leviathan - that resides somewhere, even after clearing the dream nodes, with the White Cat claiming that this hidden force is subconsciously manipulating people's dreams in Ragunna. This has caused the release of the Nightmare variants to now exist across different areas in Ragunna. The Ebony Gatekeeper also aiding in maintaining and preventing what this hidden force, as he calls it, a "spiritual plague", from infecting the rest of the Somnoire with the Rover's assistance. 

Another example of intrusions comes from those who have perished. After the halt of the [[When the Night Knocks|Somnoire Expansion]], the dreams of those who died from the [[Black Shores]] began [[Depths of Illusive Realm/2024-11-14|gathering]] and took the form of [[Fallacy of No Return]], which endangered the realm and required the [[Shorekeeper|Shorekeepers']] assistance. Another took the form of an [[If You Gaze Into the Abyss of Dreams/Story|incident]] where the Ivory Gatekeeper accidentally opened a gate which unleashing deadly nightmares, nightmares that only existed due to the interference of Leviathan itself who had placed a spiritual plague on Rinascita's people. 

===Outside Dimensional Intrusions===
Depending on the circumstances, the Somnoire could be altered by outside forces. During [[Depths of Illusive Realm/2026-05-21|Chromatic Fantasy]], a gateway that acts as both the entrance and exit to the Somnore appeared in [[Lahai-Roi]], except it became linked with Honami City and mixed them together, which forced Namipon to aid in the events. Namipon explains that this was caused by the [[Left Behind]] in Honami City, whose dreams manifested in a corner of Lahai-Roi which caused fantasy and reality to overlap into a chaotic disorder within the Somnoire which Namipon calls “Lost Dreams”.

However, Namipon claims the Left Behind alone couldn’t have caused this with “Dorothy” confirming this as she reveals that a frequency not of Solaris-3 found it’s way into the Somnoire somehow, triggering the realm’s defense mechanisms without the Gatekeepers noticing. This resulted in the dreamscape layers piling atop one another and “accidently” bridging the Left Behind’s dreams with Lahai-Roi, with the breach unable to be patched anytime soon but was stabilized thanks to Rover’s assistance. 

This intrusion however would lead to the events of [[At Dream's Edge]]. The incident was unintentionally caused by [[Lucy]], who’s dream connected with the Somnoire despite being from another reality altogether and caused the birth of, [[Rebecca]], Adam Smasher, the [[Somnoire: Night City]], and the Dream Band to appear. This formed a gateway connecting Solaris-3 and Lucy's native universe that remained in the deepest layer of the Somnoire. The Ivory Gatekeeper states the fact that two universes connecting through the Somnoire was a first for him. 

The fallout of Lucy's arrival caused a gateway within the Somnore to materialize at Startorch Academy, which began contaminating both the surrounding area through an abnormal frequency at the academy and the Somnoire itself, forcing the Ebony Gatekeeper to handle the contaminated sectors in the background. Similar to the Ebony Gatekeeper’s plans, the Ivory Gatekeeper states if the gateway in Lahai-Roi were allowed to spread the abnormal frequencies, everyone would be pulled into the Somnoire and never awaken again. Lucy's arrival also caused unique Nightmare Tacet Discords to form from her fears who began an invasion across reality and would persist unless Lucy overcame her past traumas or continue spreading themselves and the contamination without stop. After the events in Adam Smasher’s defeat, the source of the contamination, Lucy could return back to her native universe which would stabilize the two worlds at the price of the events fading away like a dream with none, not even Lucy, recalling the adventure beyond a few like Rover. The Ivory Gatekeeper claimed Lucy could have potentially stayed in the Somnoire through an unknown method, but she refused, however and returned home.

===Outside Dimensional Influence===
During the events of Lucy's arrival in [[At Dream's Edge]], a unique form of Nightmare Tacet Discords manifested in the Somnoire that came to be from Lucy's fears. Being more self-aware and intelligence, they were led by the Nightmare Tacet Discord Adam Smasher, who sought to haunt Lucy and spread his contamination across Lahai-Roi alongside the Somnoire through assimilation. 

They were able to manifest outside the Somnoire and invade reality, which Abby states should be impossible as there was no gateway to allow their exit. Due to their unique frequencies, attacks that didn’t come from Lucy, Rebecca, and Rover’s power of Seperation were ineffective towards them, as Lynae noted when attacking them and could do little damage. Moryne states that their frequencies can somehow weaken and neutralize Lahai-Roi’s weapons’ attacks, thus the requirement to study Lucy and Rebecca’s weapon frequency to apply onto the region’s weapons.  

Though willing to harm others, they were primarily targeting Lucy. This is due to Adam Smasher’s connection to her as one born of her fears of his original-self, and sought to target her weakness in what’s suggested to be an attempt to ensure she never mentally recovered from her fears of the original as he could only exist so long as she never moves past her nightmares. Thus the requirement of the Dream Band, which could counteract his powers. Though the Ivory Gatekeeper admitted that as a last resort, killing Lucy would also help as it would cause the numerous Nightmare TD’s to vanish without their source. This is primarily because Adam Smasher was considered immortal and invulnerable so long as Lucy continued to fear him.

Upon his defeat, the damage wrought by him and his forced cleared away with the contamination returning to normal. 

==Solaris Film Festival Layer==
A strange layer within the Somnoire from the deeper layers which has only recently opened where a set amount of inhabitants, a crew of seven, have made "films" based on the dreams and frequencies within the Somnoire. These films utilize familiar faces which may in turn give them similar personalities based on those they were based on. The source and potential hosts of the layer is also powerful enough to ensure none but those invited can enter. Being powerful enough to manifest an invitation into the real world, breaking the boundary of dreams and reality itself.

The Rover is allowed entry and is the only one that can be accepted within it, denying even the Ivory and Ebony Gatekeepers themselves. In turn, the Rover can view but also interact within the observed films while gaining newly enhanced abilities within while working alongside the "actors" of the film itself during the interaction. 

==Inhabitants==
The Somnoire is home to certain beings which include:
* [[Illusia]]: The primary inhabitants are known as Illusias.  They are described as virtual entities, a conglomeration of the countless consciousnesses within the Gate. They are stated by the Ebony Gatekeeper to be those who dream, though don't truly exist and have formed due to the gate that leads into the realm. They may give Tokens and other items to those who enter the realm. 
* Dreamers: Those who dream and thus are recorded by the Somnoire. Onlookers who enter may find themselves observe another person's dream, allowing them to gain the aid of said dreamer by having an aspect of them, or [[Depths of Illusive Realm/Metaphors|Metaphor]] as it's called, for support. During the expansion of the Somnoire, the Rover could enter these dreams while said Dreamers were more aware due to a piece of their original-selves becoming trapped in the Somnoire until they were released.
* Gatekeepers: The two Gatekeepers that keep watch over the Somnoire. While the role of the Ivory Gatekeeper remains unknown, the Ebony Gatekeeper's duty is to erase useless dreams that won't help in vanquishing [[the Lament]]. They both, however, are tasked with protecting the realm from disruptive elements known to enter the Somnoire, as per their duty, ensuring the stability of its dream capacity. As such, both hold certain control over the Somnoire for their duties. 
* Tacet Discords: Due to the Somnoire containing traits similar to the Tacet Fields, Tacet Discords are capable of being born in the Somnoire. Though they are considered dangerous elements in the realm that shouldn't belong and are capable of exiting it if a gateway exists, which may cause a TD Outbreak. 
* Dorothy and friends: An unknown figure who posed as "Cosmo", claims that she and her friends reside in the Somnoire itself.  However, she also states that at some point they had lived in Solaris-3 before entering through the Gate like Rover had, though refused to explain further. Later revealed to be the Ebony Gatekeeper himself, tricking the Rover for his plans during "When the Night Knocks", only to be rebutted when it was just him taking her form. Unlike her friends, Dorothy is also capable of leaving the Somnoire, but only for small periods before it becomes deadly while her friends are incapable of leaving. They claim to know the Rover with Dorothy having a relationship with the Ebony Gatekeeper, implied to be friendly as he aids her at times.  She also has a hidden location to play in.
* “Dorothy”: Despite looking exactly like the original Dorothy, numerous comments coming from her suggest she either looks like the original or takes over Dorothy’s body. She claims to know Rover but is cryptic about it and states she was created by someone she called "Mom", who she has not seen in a while.
* Solaris Film Festival Crew and Guests: Other inhabitants of the Somnoire, those who come from a layer that make films, utilizing the memories and frequencies of the Somnoire itself to create them. The Rover can interact within these films, made by about seven people which can be seen by other inhabitants within other layers of the Somnoire. 
* [[D]]: One of the visitors and viewers of the films made in the Somnoire.
